# GSAP

Pinned GSAP 3.13.0 distribution (trailing whitespace normalized) from:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js

Copyright and license notice are preserved in the distribution header.
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

Used only as progressive motion enhancement. No scores or result bands are calculated by this library or by the page JavaScript.
